latest.title: Laplace and Dolbeault operators on Sasakian manifolds
latest.abstract: Sasakian manifolds, the odd-dimensional analogues of Kähler manifolds, carry two natural pairs of first-order Dolbeault-type operators on the full complex of differential forms, extending the Kohn--Rossi differentials. On such Sasaki manifolds, we establish Kähler-type identities for these operators, and relate the resulting Dolbeault Laplacians to the Hodge Laplacian. Unlike the Kähler case, where $Δ=2Δ_{\overline\partial}$, the relation has extra terms coming from the Reeb flow. Using these formulas and a Lefschetz decomposition, we derive lower and upper eigenvalue estimates for $Δ$ on forms depending on the eigenvalues of the Lie derivative of the Reeb vector field.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在 Sasakian 流形的完整微分形式复形上研究两对 Dolbeault 型一阶算子，建立 Kähler 型恒等式，描述它们的 Laplacian 与 Hodge Laplacian 之间由 Reeb 流产生的修正项。
latest.breakthrough: 不局限于横向或基本形式，把 Sasakian 几何中的 Hodge 与 Dolbeault 谱联系提升到全形式层面，并导出依赖 Reeb 特征值的上下界。
latest.limitations: 已检查的是元数据与摘要；估计涉及 Reeb 流特征值，不能视为对所有 Sasakian 度量统一的无条件数值界。具体紧致性及谱分解假设仍需按正文使用。
latest.priorityReason: 特殊几何与谱理论相关性高，算子恒等式有迁移潜力；当前证据支持一套结构性工具，优先级低于当日已核验主定理的猜想解决与大范围推广。
